audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart gives Yone all seven rows while content win[] and the packet both flip to Veigar from level 6 on.
audit.why: At 6 Veigar's cage answers the telegraphed 1000-range R engage; with items he one-shots through the Soul Unbound snapback. Content and packet agree.
audit.corrected: Full phases[4-6].side moved to Veigar with whys rewritten.

audit.why: Spike shape (Yone 3-5, Veigar from 6/first item/late) is right; ability names on the content side are real.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content text repeatedly assigned Veigar's stun to W: 'body-block enough W stun casts' (whys[2] wording), 'Hold W as a peel button' (spikes[0]), 'Save W to interrupt' (mid), 'before you have W up' / 'Bait your W stun' (wants.foe). Veigar's stun is E (Event Horizon); W is Dark Matter and interrupts nothing. Also missing: Spirit Cleave's shield absorbing the burst window; no cooldown digits.
audit.why: Owner kit: E carries the hardCC flag, W does not. Enemy kit: W shields on ~14s, E is 22s rank 1 / 10s max.
audit.corrected: All W-as-stun references corrected to E/cage; shield-force-out added to breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2]; real numbers written in.

audit.why: Soul Unbound 22-10s is the punish window.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad bleed.
audit.corrected: Rewritten grounded in the edge-stun window and his passive/shield.

audit.why: Nothing verifiable from kits; nothing asserted.

edits.before: Primordial Burst online — anyone under half is now a math problem with one answer. Count R damage out loud.
edits.after: At 6 his R telegraphs from 1000 range — self-cage the landing spot, W the stun, and R turns his engage into a kill.

edits.before: Luden's spike: cage-W-Q-R deletes squishies who touch the wall. Your zone is a courtroom now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter spike: E-W-Q chunks half his bar — he has no ranged answer and must all-in low.

edits.before: Late Veigar IS the scaling argument: cage the choke, burst the carry, and let infinite AP write the closing statement.
edits.after: Two-plus items you one-shot him even through Soul Unbound's snapback — every dash he spends is a caged death.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Yone wins by chaining Q3 knock-up into Soul Unbound burst pre-6, shielding your answer with Spirit Cleave as he leaves.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Event Horizon (self-cage) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound (E) is 22s at rank 1, 10s max — his burst window; survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - Spirit Cleave (W) shields on a ~14s base cooldown: force it out before you commit the combo. - Your R at 120/90/60s goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: When he clips the cage edge, the stun is long enough for W plus Q — that chunk beats anything he wins with his dashes.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: His passive crit and every-second-hit magic damage win any auto war, and Spirit Cleave shields your poke back — spells only.

edits.before: Level 3 he can chain Q3 plus E all-in and burst you before enough W stuns land.
edits.after: Level 3 he can chain Q3 plus E all-in and burst you before your E stun answers.

edits.before: Yone owns this window: with Q stacks he can Q3 knock-up onto you, E-dash in, and burst you before you can body-block enough W stun casts. Hold W in your back pocket as a peel button, not a poke tool, and never step to a minion inside his E-recall range.
edits.after: Yone owns this window: with Q stacks he can Q3 knock-up onto you, E-dash in, and burst you before your Event Horizon stun can answer. Hold E in your back pocket as a peel button, not an engage tool, and never step to a minion inside his E-recall range.

edits.before: From 3 to 5 you are still on the back foot against his dash-in burst, but everything pivots at 6: your R plus a landed E cage answers his all-in and lets you punish the moment he R-dashes onto you. Save W to interrupt, not to trade.
edits.after: From 3 to 5 you are still on the back foot against his dash-in burst, but everything pivots at 6: your R plus a landed E cage answers his all-in and lets you punish the moment he R-dashes onto you. Save E for his engage, not for poke.

edits.before: Catch you with Q3 + E before you have W up
edits.after: Catch you with Q3 + E before your cage is up

edits.before: Bait your W stun then re-engage with his second E cast
edits.after: Bait your cage stun then re-engage with his second E cast

notes: Level chart aligned: full rows 4-6 moved to Veigar to match content win[] and the packet (which agree); no win[N] edits needed. Main mechanical fix: several content fields treated Veigar's W as his stun — the stun is E (Event Horizon); corrected everywhere it appeared. spikes[1]'s 'W the stun' reads as dropping W onto the stunned target and was left. Packet defect 'never names any of Yone's abilities' applies to the full layer; real names (Soul Unbound, Spirit Cleave, Q3/Mortal Steel) are now woven into enemyWin, cooldowns and phases whys. Full diff HARD 8/10 vs 53.57% Veigar win rate flagged, not changed (not kit-verifiable). Yone is male; pronouns correct.
